project_name: SolarSense - Predictive Solar Array Monitoring Platform

typography.telemetry_value: font-mono font-bold tracking-tight text-2xl sm:text-3xl text-primary

layout_and_navigation.structure: Sidebar + Sticky Top Header with Real-time Clock, Telemetry Status Indicator, Simulation Controls (Pause/Resume, Clock Speed, Anomaly Rate), Theme Toggle, and Navigation Tabs

navigation_tabs.label: Overview & Live Telemetry
navigation_tabs.description: Live KPI cards, 24h Yield Actual vs Expected, Residuals, Weather conditions, Anomaly Stream

navigation_tabs.label: Panel Array Digital Twin
navigation_tabs.description: 6x8 Interactive grid map of solar panels with real-time health, soiling, and fault indicators

navigation_tabs.label: What-If Yield Predictor
navigation_tabs.description: XGBoost ML model inference calculator with interactive sliders and financial revenue loss estimation

navigation_tabs.label: ML Lab & DBSCAN Anomaly Engine
navigation_tabs.description: Hardware degradation clusters, feature importance, residual distribution, and evaluation metrics (MAE/MSE)

navigation_tabs.label: AI Maintenance Assistant
navigation_tabs.description: LLM Copilot for diagnostic troubleshooting, automated work order recommendations, and hardware advice

navigation_tabs.label: Pipeline & Digital Twin Arch
navigation_tabs.description: System architecture diagram, live telemetry generator specifications, simulator speed controls, and CSV telemetry export

key_components.name: LiveKPICard
key_components.purpose: Displays critical telemetry metric (Yield, Efficiency %, Irradiance, Module Temp, Degradation, Uptime)
key_components.features: Subtle border, live pulsing trend indicator, comparison delta with historical average, tooltip explanation

key_components.name: PanelArrayGrid
key_components.purpose: Visualizes 48 solar panels (6x8 grid) with color-coded health status
key_components.features: Hover inspection tooltip, click to open panel detail drawer, status filter (All, Faulted, Soiled, Degrading, Healthy), quick batch diagnostic trigger

key_components.name: YieldComparisonChart
key_components.purpose: Dual-line area chart comparing expected yield vs actual yield over rolling 24 points
key_components.features: Custom tooltips with residual diff, gradient fill under lines, anomaly timestamp markers

key_components.name: ResidualChart
key_components.purpose: Bar/Line chart of yield error residual (Actual - Expected)
key_components.features: Color scale for normal vs anomalous error thresholds, zero line reference

key_components.name: WhatIfPredictorForm
key_components.purpose: Interactive parameter tweaking (Hour, Temp, Module Temp, Irradiance, Cloud Cover)
key_components.features: Real-time API POST /predict call, comparison against baseline, financial impact calculator ($ / kWh)

key_components.name: DBSCANClusterPlot
key_components.purpose: Scatter plot visualizing DBSCAN hardware degradation clusters (Normal vs Soiling vs Inverter Failure vs Unknown)
key_components.features: Cluster legend, point selection, noise/outlier highlighting

key_components.name: AIMaintenanceAssistant
key_components.purpose: AI Copilot chat interface with pre-built prompt triggers ('Explain panel P-7 fault', 'Generate maintenance schedule', 'Calculate cleaning ROI')
key_components.features: Streaming response UI, copy suggestion button, diagnostic summary export

key_components.name: SimulatorController
key_components.purpose: Control bar for live digital twin telemetry generator
key_components.features: Play/Pause tick, tick interval speed (1x, 2x, 5x), force anomaly injection, anomaly probability rate slider, tick counter display

general: Use JavaScript React (.js extension) for all frontend code.
Ensure all interactive elements and data displays contain data-testid attributes for reliable testing.
Implement a clean theme toggle allowing the user to switch between 'Dark Industrial Control-Room' and 'Light Clean Energy' aesthetics seamlessly.
Maintain active telemetry pooling from the FastAPI backend endpoint /api/telemetry, /api/anomalies, and /api/predict.
Handle offline or simulated clock ticks gracefully with clear visual indicators when simulation is paused or active.
Use recharts for all interactive charts (Yield comparison, Residuals, DBSCAN scatter plot, Feature Importance).
Include CSV Export functionality for telemetry and anomaly data on the Overview and Architecture pages.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing_attributes: All buttons, inputs, tabs, selects, modal triggers, and KPI cards MUST have data-testid attributes using kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='tab-overview', data-testid='kpi-current-yield', data-testid='predict-submit-btn').

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_ratio: WCAG AA compliant across both light and dark themes
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.responsive: Mobile-first responsive layout with sidebar collapse capability
